mapper.sql: select action_id, idempotency_key, action_type, user_id, thread_id, region_id, inner_code, action_desc, status, created_at, expires_at, decided_at, decided_by, executed_at, task_id, task_code, last_error_code from ai_agent_action
mapper.update: update ai_agent_action set status = #{status}, action_desc = #{actionDesc}, decided_at = #{decidedAt}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, last_error_code = null where action_id = #{actionId}
update ai_agent_action set status = 'SUCCEEDED', task_id = #{taskId}, task_code = #{taskCode}, executed_at = #{executedAt}, last_error_code = null where action_id = #{actionId}
